query:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS max_snap
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
domestic_workers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.id, hl.region AS sponsor_region
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
    JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON hp.snapshot = ls.max_snap
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
    WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE
      AND hp.occupation_category = 'عامل منزلي'
)
SELECT sponsor_region, COUNT(*) AS worker_count
FROM domestic_workers
WHERE sponsor_region IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sponsor_region
ORDER BY worker_count DESC LIMIT 20000
